sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at The Sandbach Community Football Centre in a direct clash between 3rd and 4th place. This is a significant matchup as Sandbach look to build on their recent draw and impressive 5-game unbeaten run, while Eccleshall arrive on the back of a 4-game winning streak. Both sides will be eager to consolidate their positions near the top of the table in what promises to be a competitive encounter.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth (1st) face a stern test against Brereton Social away, while defending champions Stafford Town (2nd) visit struggling Cheadle Heath Nomads. The Foley Meir v Widnes Town fixture at Trentham Foods Stadium sees the hosts looking to bounce back after recent mixed form against a Widnes side desperately seeking their first win. New Mills host Dawley Town in a mid-table clash between two sides with modest records. Bilston Town, who've shown decent form recently, travel to face Market Drayton Town in a battle involving a team struggling for consistency. Crewe welcome Wednesfield Community in what both sides will view as an opportunity to pick up points given their positions in the lower half. Shawbury United host Wolverhampton Casuals in another lower-table encounter, while Telford Town travel to Barnton looking to end a recent poor run. Finally, Allscott Heath host Alsager Town after Allscott's impressive 7-1 away win last weekend, with the visitors acknowledging they face an uphill task against improved opposition.
